Delhi armies sacked capital Dorasamudra 1311 and 1326 (inside W); Ballala III killed fighting the Madurai Sultanate 1343; Vijayanagara took over Hoysala lands by c.1346 with little recorded fighting, so T3 is arguable. Core capital ambiguous.

Charles IV's death in 1328 ended the direct Capetian line; Philip VI of Valois, a Capetian branch, succeeded and royal government continued. Prior unrest: baronial leagues 1314-15, Great Famine 1315-17, Flemish revolt 1323-28.

notes: Archaeological phase without recorded central authority. Met essay states much continuity between Ubaid and the succeeding Uruk period, traditions elaborated; Eridu occupied continuously with superimposed temples. No evidence of replacement or conquest. Conventional dates.
